About

Presentations built by someone who has stood in the room and pitched them.

I run Javel Materials and Services Inc. and take on freelance, project-based work as a presentation specialist — building the pitch decks, capability decks, and investor narratives that teams use to get into the room and close.

Every deck I build is informed by the same throughline: clarity that persuades. I’ve sat on both sides of the pitch, so the decks are built to be presented, not just read.
